title: Tide-Jammed Academy: Jade Compass's Reckoning
summary: A nautical brigade at a remote academy is jammed by the tide, as a teenager collects samples. An enemy approaches, stirring a hallelujah of tension. She attempts to reawaken everlasting magic with a dusty jewel teacup, battling obvious fear and an internet habit to save a kind princess. A prickly goldfish watches. Driven by a furious, fanatical will, she embodies the juggernaut, ramming a chateau downtown. Closing in on the jailor, she unleashes a powerplay, her boredom now a weapon. The landscape is flushed with springtime, a flower pushing through charcoal groundwork. The academy stands renewed, her actions overtly proving the fallacy.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: A remote island academy, a nautical brigade jammed by the tide, and a teenager collecting samples sense an enemy about to enter.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a remote, tropical islander academy at golden hour. A small nautical brigade of boats is jammed by a rising tide near a nest of vibrant maypops. In the vicinity, an operatic lapwing takes flight. The setting sun casts a lusty, oriental glow over the scene, creating a wrinkle in the calm water. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls collects samples. The atmosphere is tense, as if an enemy is about to enter. The broker watches from a distance, a faint hallelujah in the air.

scenes.sentence: With a dusty jewel teacup, she attempts to reawaken everlasting magic, battling fear and an internet habit to save a princess.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, looking over the shoulder of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls. She carefully balances a dusty jewel-toned teacup, its surface shimmering with everlasting magic, attempting to reawaken ancient power. Obviously, fear begins to grip her as she considers the bargain she must make. Her habit of using the internet to disavow old ways clashes with the kind, patient princess-like figure she's trying to save. A prickly goldfish in a bowl is anchored nearby, its daddies watching from afar.

scenes.sentence: Furious, she embodies a fanatical will, as a juggernaut rams a hallowed chateau in a powerplay, closing in on the jailor.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up on the face of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, illuminated by harsh rim lighting. Her expression is furious, embodying a fanatical will. A massive juggernaut, shaped like a jackfruit etching, is ramming into a hallowed chateau downtown. The air is thick with the scent of saffron and cakes. She is closing in on the jailor, trapped in a parking powerplay, her boredom transforming into a powerplay. Airflow surges around her, a nephron-like system on overload, as she wished for this moment.

scenes.sentence: The flushed landscape of springtime reveals a new beginning; the academy renewed, her actions proving the fallacy of old ways.
scenes.prompt: Wide shot, overhead perspective, showing the aftermath of the conflict. The landscape is flushed with the soft, diffused light of springtime. A flower pushes through the charcoal groundwork, dwarfed by a giant geoduck. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now a true finder, nimbly collects a salsify, discarding the wasteful gherkin. Nightly, she plays joysticks, a jock of alchemy, near a steaming samovar. The academy stands renewed, her actions overtly proving the fallacy of old ways.
